title: Installing MongoDB
subtitle: Setting up MongoDB locally and connecting with mongosh

content.text: MongoDB Community Edition is free and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. For development, MongoDB Atlas offers a free cloud cluster.

content.code:
# macOS (Homebrew)
brew tap mongodb/brew
brew install mongodb-community
brew services start mongodb-community

# Windows: download installer from mongodb.com/try/download

# Connect with mongosh
mongosh
# or connect to a URI
mongosh "mongodb://localhost:27017"

content.text: Use MongoDB Atlas Free Tier for zero-install cloud development.

questions.question: What is mongosh?
options: The MongoDB shell for running commands
questions.explanation: mongosh is the MongoDB Shell — an interactive JavaScript environment for MongoDB.

faq.q: How do I connect to Atlas from mongosh?
faq.a: Use mongosh with the connection string from the Atlas Connect dialog, e.g. mongosh "mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.mongodb.net/mydb"
